verdict.rationale: Fedora's official Workstation page explicitly states that users can "use performance mode to boost hardware speed when you need it," which directly matches the on-demand performance toggle in the story. The support rests on a single repeated marketing line. Community posts about RAM freezes, Nvidia drivers and Wayland are not about this feature and are disregarded. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how the toggle works (location, hardware/power-profile requirements), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
